phase: Desktop WebGPU stutter profiling and quality-preserving optimization

references.application: Production reproduction, correct served build, loop ownership, frame pacing, CPU/GPU classification and exact-path retest.
Frame-aware actor-state verification and focused program lifecycle tracing on the unchanged production build.
Fixed desktop viewport and quality, baseline/post frame-time distributions, allocation and draw-work inspection.
Preserve complete source assets, native pixel ratio, material/shadow detail, animation sampling and walking behavior while reducing redundant work.
Actual WebGPU/backend verification; separate startup, CPU callback, frame interval and GPU timing; source/build-bound repeatable comparisons with no competing Blender render.

scope: Desktop production preview at localhost only; isolated headless testing does not control the user's browser.
qualityContract: No mesh simplification, LOD substitutions, crowd billboards, reduced animation rate, texture compression/downsampling, adaptive resolution or reduced lighting features. Correct per-pass culling and shared resources are allowed.
completion: Reference review complete; measured results are owned by the linked performance evidence.
rejectedExperiment: Static command bundles were rejected after visible seating differences; failed comparison evidence is retained separately and does not establish production correctness.
